construct: M1c x M5c: single-instrument extreme displacement from session VWAP, contrarian (reversion) direction

hypothesis.H1: Mean forward return in the reversion direction (long after negative displacement, short after positive) is > 0 at each of 5 horizons, separately for each displacement sign
hypothesis.alternative_not_tested: continuation (mean < 0) is a distinct finding, reported but never re-labelled as support

data.session_selection: weekdays with a store file, excluding core.market.session_schedule.SPECIAL_SESSIONS (3 Muhurat + 2 special Saturdays)
data.valid_bar: stored, is_synthetic = FALSE, volume > 0, all prices > 0; every other slot is missing (never imputed, never forward-filled)
data.price_basis: CA-adjusted 1m prices; every quantity is a within-session ratio or a within-session return, so the adjustment basis cancels; overnight returns are never used

universe.primary: PIT F&O members: a FUTSTK contract on the underlying traded that session (futures_bhavcopy), joined via ISIN with rename closure, present in the 1m store that session
universe.membership_source: scripts/vwap_rev/universe.py reusing scripts.isd.build_pit_universe helpers; agreement with certified ISD pit_universe on the overlap is asserted
universe.coverage_disclosure: Outcome-free census: the 1m store carries ~140 of ~191 PIT F&O underlyings in 2023-2024 (73%), rising to ~172 from Dec-2024 and ~100% from mid-2025; 62 of the 98 sampled absent underlyings are no longer F&O by 2026-09-29. The tested universe is therefore 'PIT F&O members that the store carries', which is survivorship-shaped in TRAIN/early-VAL (names later dropped from F&O are under-represented) and broadens over time. Composition is reported per stage; liquidity terciles and an all-symbols universe are robustness-only.
universe.certified_table_finding: Recomputed membership is a strict superset of the certified ISD pit_universe fno flag (0 certified-only symbol-sessions; 7,334 recomputed-only, concentrated in 8 names verified to have FUTSTK contracts: DLF, BRITANNIA, KOTAKBANK, BAJAJFINSV, ABB, MOTHERSON, CHOLAFIN, PIIND). The certified artifact is not modified.

vwap.primary: cumulative session VWAP through decision bar k inclusive = sum(typical_price*volume)/sum(volume) over valid bars from 09:15; typical_price = (H+L+C)/3
vwap.partial_sessions: a name-bar is eligible only if valid bars / elapsed bars >= 0.90 through the decision bar (information available at decision time only)

displacement.primary: z = (close_k - VWAP_k) / (VWAP_k * sigma_prior * sqrt(D)), D = k+1 elapsed minutes since 09:15
displacement.sigma_prior: mean over the prior 20 sessions (strictly before today; >= 15 available) of that name's per-session RMS of consecutive valid 1m log-returns (>= 200 return pairs); today's data never enters

extreme_threshold.primary: |z| >= c[b] where c[b] = q-quantile of |z| pooled over ALL eligible universe name-bars of the PRIOR 60 sessions in the same 15-minute decision bucket b (16 buckets covering D in [60,295]); symmetric in sign; today and future sessions never enter
extreme_threshold.q_selection_rule: Outcome-free: among q in {0.99,0.995,0.999} choose the q whose TRAIN event incidence (share of eligible name-sessions with >=1 event, both sides) is closest to 10% (M1c ledger precedent: ~10% of name-sessions); ties to larger q. No forward return, entry or exit price was computed when the rule was evaluated.

decision_window.clock: 10:15 - 14:10 (decision at close of bar k, k in slots 59..294)
decision_window.why: 60 minutes of VWAP formation; every horizon (max 60) exits by 15:10, before the CAS carry-forward region (15:15+) and MIS square-off (15:12), identically in every era

event_rules.trigger: first qualifying decision bar per (name, session, side)
event_rules.sides: z>0 up-displacement -> short in reversion direction; z<0 down-displacement -> long
event_rules.overlap: same-name same-side events cannot overlap (one per session); opposite-side events are both kept; cross-name overlap is handled by session-level aggregation

outcome.entry: OPEN of bar k+1 (first tradable price after the decision bar closes); missing entry bar -> NaN
outcome.exit: CLOSE of bar k+H, H bars held from the entry open; missing exit bar -> NaN, no imputation
outcome.primary_statistic: R_H = reversion-direction gross return in bp = sign * (exit/entry - 1) * 1e4
secondary_per_event: excess return over the equal-weight universe return in the identical window

splits.discipline: no parameter is tuned; TRAIN is discovery/diagnostic; VAL is the first confirmatory stage; HOLDOUT is evaluated exactly once, after everything below is frozen

inference.unit: the session: for each (stage, side, horizon) the events of a session are averaged into one number (equal weight per event within session); the session series is the sample
inference.primary_test: mean of the session series > 0, Newey-West (Bartlett, lag floor(4*(n/100)^(2/9))) one-sided p, Student-t n-1 df
inference.ci: 95% circular moving-block bootstrap CI of the session-series mean (block = NW lag + 1, 10000 reps, seed 20260930)
secondary: event-level pooled mean with two-way (name x session) clustered SE
unweighted-by-event session mean vs event-weighted mean
inference.family: 10 cells = 2 sides x 5 horizons; Holm-Bonferroni within stage at alpha = 0.05 (one-sided)
inference.confirmation_rule: a cell is VAL-confirmed iff Holm-adjusted p < 0.05 in VAL; it is HOLDOUT-confirmed iff it is VAL-confirmed AND HOLDOUT one-sided p < 0.05 (Holm over the VAL-confirmed cells) with the same sign; TRAIN is descriptive only

economics.cost_model: core/execution/equity/intraday_fees.round_trip_fees at Rs 5,00,000 ticket (era-accurate dates) + slippage kappa bp per side
economics.kappa_source: ISD G6b measured drift_p90_abs bp per liquidity decile (2.35-2.90, pooled ~2.75)
economics.economic_gate: phenomenon is 'economically meaningful' only if HOLDOUT net mean at the base scenario is > 0 with a bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0 in at least one HOLDOUT-confirmed cell
economics.not_a_strategy: no sizing, no portfolio, no capital, no stops

robustness_only_labels: every variation below is POST-PRIMARY and labelled; none is ever promoted

robustness.threshold_q: the two candidate q values not chosen
robustness.vol_regime: prior-session India VIX close, expanding-window terciles (>= 60 sessions)
robustness.market_regime: Nifty 50 trailing-60-session return at prior close: >= +5% bull, <= -5% bear, else choppy
robustness.liquidity: terciles of prior-20-session mean traded value within the session's eligible universe
robustness.stock_volatility: terciles of sigma_prior within the session's eligible universe

classification.vocabulary_note: C0-C9 as applied in RESEARCH_CLOSURE_LEDGER_2026-09-29: C5 = predefined criterion tested and failed; C6 = positive but incomplete; C7 = HOLDOUT-confirmed (complete statistical chain); C8 = economically confirmed; C9 = replicated/stable across independent windows. The repo does not define C7-C9 textually; this mapping is inferred from ledger usage and is stated, not assumed.
rules: C8: >=1 cell VAL-confirmed AND HOLDOUT-confirmed AND HOLDOUT net (base kappa) bootstrap CI lower bound > 0 in that cell
C7: >=1 cell VAL-confirmed AND HOLDOUT-confirmed but the economic gate fails (real but sub-cost phenomenon; economics stated separately)
C6: >=1 cell VAL-confirmed and HOLDOUT positive-signed but not significant, or confirmation only in a single stage/sub-period

C5: no cell VAL-confirmed, or VAL-confirmed and HOLDOUT null/reversed -- criterion-scoped failure; a precision statement (HOLDOUT MDE, 95% CI upper bound vs the base round-trip cost) accompanies it and the report states whether the null rules out an economically meaningful effect
C4/unresolved: a data or methodological defect voids the read (stated with the defect)
C9 is not reachable in this experiment (no independent replication window exists)
classification.continuation_finding: a significant NEGATIVE mean (continuation) in any cell is reported as a distinct empirical finding; it is not support for H1 and does not change the H1 classification
